methodology.population: Latest available Eurostat City Statistics observation for total population on 1 January. The city label and reference year are retained because several countries report a greater-city boundary or an older vintage.
methodology.tourism: 2024 nights in tourist accommodation establishments for selected cities, NACE I551-I553, from Eurostat. Dublin and London use official local fallbacks because those cities are absent from the Eurostat selected-city table.
methodology.comparison_warning: Eurostat tourist nights cover registered accommodation establishments and may exclude small establishments. Dublin and London fallbacks cover a broader visitor-survey universe and belong to a different comparability group.
methodology.derived_metrics: Non-resident share is non-resident nights divided by total nights. Nights per resident divides the tourism-period nights by the latest available population and is flagged when reference years differ.
